_comment: Genre settings. 'always_edm' / 'always_live' are YOUR final word — put an artist name in one of these and it is labelled that way everywhere, overriding everything else. 'edm' is a keyword list used only when no stronger signal exists (matching is whole-word and case-insensitive). Automatic sources, strongest first: your lists -> the venue's own genre label or a single-genre venue -> the same artist's genre at another venue -> MusicBrainz -> these keywords -> the venue's usual leaning.
